en.bdb: One Onkaar,the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sat roop gur dharasano pooran braham acharaj dhikhaiaa|

en.bdb: The glimpse of the Guru (Nanak Dev) is in the form of truth which has brought me face to face with the perfect and wondrous

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satinaam karataa purakh paarabraham paramesar dhiaaiaa|

en.bdb: Bestowing upon the people the mantra of true Name and the creator Lord, he has made the people remember the transcendent B

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sabadh giaan sach anahadh dhun visamaadh sunaiaa|

en.bdb: The knowledge of truth is the Word of the Guru, through which the wonder inspiring unstruck melody is heard.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th chalaion naam dhaan isanaan dhiraRaiaa|

en.bdb: Initiating the gurmukh-panth, (Sikhism, the highway for gurmukhs) the Guru inspired one and all to be steadfastly absorbed

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਦੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁਖੰਡੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikh dhe gur sikh kar saadhasa(n)gat sachukha(n)dd vasaiaa|

en.bdb: Educating the people and making them his disciples, the Gum has founded holy congregation, the abode of truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਦੇ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach raas raharaas dhe satigur sikh dhe pairee paiaa|

en.bdb: Handing over the capital of truth to the people, the Guru made them bow at the (lotus) feet (of the Lord).
He made people understand the glory of the feet (of the Lord).
